title: Colon Collection and Preparation for Index Calculation and Immunohistochemistry
author: Amandine EVEN
materials: The colon is weighed with a precision scale.

steps.title: Weigh mouse
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse on a balance; record body mass in grams for later colon index calculation.

steps.title: Remove feces
steps.instruction: If present, gently slide forceps along the colon from the proximal to the distal part to expel the feces.

steps.title: Euthanize and dissect colon
steps.instruction: Perform an appropriate euthanasia, then dissect out the caecum and the colon; the colon is the segment between the caecum and the anus.

steps.title: Calculate colon index
steps.instruction: Weigh the colon (mg) and compute the colon index as colon mass (mg) divided by mouse body mass (g).

steps.title: Section colon in half
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel blade, cut the colon into two portions: proximal portion from the caecum to the middle, and distal portion from the middle to the anus.

steps.title: Place sections in cold PBS
steps.instruction: Transfer the colon sections into a petri dish filled with cold 1X PBS.

steps.title: Flush colon lumen
steps.instruction: With a 10 mL syringe and a 21 G needle, gently flush the interior of each colon section with cold 1X PBS until completely clean; apply a steady flow to distend the colon and avoid touching the tissue with the needle.

steps.title: Store sections for RNA/protein
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer sections into dry 2 mL tubes, place the tubes on dry ice, and after all samples are collected move the tubes to –80 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Fix sections for immunohistopathology
steps.instruction: Transfer sections into 2 mL tubes containing cold 4 % PFA and keep at 4 °C for 1–2 days before embedding.

steps.title: Fix sections for immunohistochemistry
steps.instruction: Insert sections directly into a mold, then transfer the mold into a bottle of cold formalin; keep at 4 °C for 1–2 days before embedding.

steps.title: Measure colon length
steps.instruction: Measure the length of the colon from the caecum to the end with a ruler and photograph the colon together with the ruler for record.

steps.title: Dry excess PBS
steps.instruction: Very quickly dab each section onto a Kimwipe to remove excess 1X PBS, then store the tissue.
